title: Panchayat may raise loans and form a sinking fund

versions.Latest:
163. Panchayat may raise loans and form a sinking fund.—

—   A Panchayat may, with 
the previous sanction of the Government and subject to the conditions imposed by it from 
time to time and subject to the execution of any work or for the purpose of carrying out 
any of the provisions of this Act and form a sinking fund in the prescribed manner for the 
repayment of such loans.
